featured_reviews.review_text:
We have worked with Jaywanti Mam at Arty Mélange as our daughter Asahi's arts teacher for the past five years, and it has been truly transformative for her journey toward studying industrial design abroad. Beyond building strong foundational skills in her early years, Jaywanti Mam expertly guided Aashi in creating a standout portfolio for competitive universities like RISD, Pratt Institute, Parsons School of Design, UAL, and SCAD—securing admissions with scholarships at Pratt, Parsons, and SCAD.

What sets Jaywanti Mam apart is her deep knowledge of each school's unique expectations. Her step-by-step coaching turned Asahi's ideas into professional-grade work, complete with artist statements and renders tailored for admissions. Feedback was always honest, constructive, and grounded in real-world industry standards, helping avoid pitfalls like generic designs or weak narratives. Jaywanti Mam is now a recognized name at SCAD, with many of her students thriving there.

Even online sessions were flexible, engaging, and resource-rich (software tips, mock reviews, peer critiques). This prep gave Aashi a huge edge for industrial and product design careers. If you're targeting top art/design programs abroad, Arty Mélange with Jaywanti Mam is the real deal—highly recommend!

featured_reviews.review_text:

She helped make a customized schedule to catch me up with the preparation alongside the normal classes, and was always available for feedback and advice. She does not overlook any student, and gives everyone personalised attention according to their needs and level. The classes prepare you for the theory part of entrances as well as the practical drawing section.

She rehearses and goes through everything that will help students before the exams; common types of questions for each specific exam, tips for performing under time, what each institute is looking for, common mistakes students make, how to be more efficient in your drawings etc. She helps you tranform your skill into a way you can display it in entrances. I don't think just any other teacher would have helped me prepare so thoroughly and in such a short period of time, which is what allowed me to perform well in design entrances. I highly recommend her classes for anyone who wants to push themself with a different medium, or to explore/ learn anything new in art.
